title: Talking About Your Family
context: People love talking about family. With a few simple sentences you can say who is in your family, how old they are and what they do, and ask the same questions back.
contextPersian: مردم دوست دارند دربارهٔ خانواده صحبت کنند. با چند جملهٔ ساده می‌توانی بگویی چه کسانی در خانواده‌ات هستند، چند ساله‌اند و چه کار می‌کنند، و همین سؤال‌ها را از طرف مقابل بپرسی.

expressions.example: I have two brothers and one sister.
expressions.examplePersian: من دو برادر و یک خواهر دارم.

expressions.example: This is my mother. Her name is Mina.
expressions.examplePersian: این مادر من است. اسمش مینا است.
expressions.note: For people we use this is / these are: This is my sister.

expressions.examplePersian: آن نِدا است. او خواهر من است.
پدر و مادرم در مشهد زندگی می‌کنند.
expressions.note: Parents = mother and father. Not relatives.

expressions.example: Do you have any children? — Yes, a son and a daughter.
expressions.examplePersian: بچه دارید؟ — بله، یک پسر و یک دختر.

expressions.example: We're a big family — there are seven of us.
expressions.examplePersian: ما خانوادهٔ بزرگی هستیم — هفت نفریم.

expressions.example: My brother works as an engineer.
expressions.examplePersian: برادرم مهندس است (به عنوان مهندس کار می‌کند).

expressions.example: How old is your sister? — She is eighteen.
expressions.examplePersian: خواهرت چند ساله است؟ — هجده ساله است.

expressions.example: Reza is my best friend. We met at school.
expressions.examplePersian: رضا بهترین دوست من است. در مدرسه با هم آشنا شدیم.

expressions.example: I'm married and I have one daughter.
expressions.examplePersian: من متأهل هستم و یک دختر دارم.
او با پدربزرگ و مادربزرگش زندگی می‌کند.

expressions.example: What's your mother's name? — Her name is Zahra.
expressions.examplePersian: اسم مادرت چیست؟ — اسمش زهرا است.

exercises.prompt: You point to your sister and say:
Your mother and father together are your:

exercises.hint: A verb meaning "own / there is in my family".
exercises.explanation: We say 'I have' for family members.
exercises.explanationPersian: برای اعضای خانواده می‌گوییم I have.

exercises.source: من دو خواهر و یک برادر دارم.
acceptedAnswers: I have two sisters and one brother.
I have two sisters and a brother.
I've got two sisters and one brother.
I've got two sisters and a brother.

commonErrors.feedback: 'I am have' is not correct. Use 'I have'.
commonErrors.feedbackPersian: I am have درست نیست. بگو I have.

commonErrors.feedback: Start with the subject: I have …
commonErrors.feedbackPersian: جمله را با فاعل شروع کن: I have …

exercises.explanationPersian: my best friend یعنی بهترین دوستم.

exercises.prompt: "I live with my parents and my two sisters." How many people live in the house, including the speaker?
exercises.explanationPersian: من (۱) + پدر و مادر (۲) + دو خواهر (۲) = ۵.

commonErrors.feedbackPersian: کلمهٔ درست has است، نه haves.

exercises.explanationPersian: با he / she / it از has استفاده می‌کنیم.

exercises.explanation: Do you have any children? is a natural way to ask.
exercises.explanationPersian: Do you have any children؟ روش طبیعی پرسیدن است.

speakingTask.instruction: Talk about your family: who is in it, how old they are and what they do.
speakingTask.instructionPersian: دربارهٔ خانواده‌ات بگو: چه کسانی هستند، چند ساله‌اند و چه کار می‌کنند.
modelSentences: I have two brothers and one sister.
This is my mother. She is fifty years old.
My father works as a teacher.

roleplay.objective: Say who is in your family and ask about theirs
roleplay.context: You meet a new neighbour in the lift. Talk about your families: how many brothers and sisters, who you live with, what your parents do. Keep sentences short and simple.
roleplay.opening: Hello! I'm Laura, I just moved in. Do you live here with your family?
